outcome: development of hypernatremia (mild, moderate, or severe)
cohort: 450 exclusively breastfed healthy neonates over 36 weeks' gestation.
finding: Early weight loss of >=5.5% predicted the development of hypernatremia, and >=7% predicted moderate hypernatremia, with hypernatremia potentially developing even within normal weight loss ranges if values exceed the 75th percentile.
mod_finding: Weight loss percentages within the first 24 hours were similar between infants born via cesarean section or vaginal delivery.
gest_age: Over 36 weeks; Mean 38.6 weeks (+- 1.3 weeks, range 36.0-42.3 weeks)
